title: Pukari zainab e muztar mere Hussain utho
body:
PUKARI ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR, MERE HUSSAIN UTHO
DOHAYE DETI HAI KHAWHAR, MERE HUSSAIN UTHO
Nahi hai Qasim-o-Abbas aur Ali Akber
Rabab karti hai girya bichhad gaya Asgher
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye besahara kare kya bhala watan jakar
Jafaye hoti hai hum par mere Hussain utho
Hai reg-e-garm pa pyaaso ke bekafan laashe
Ye jaa’n nisaar mujahid ye khastatan laashe
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai run mein Aun-o-Mohammed ke gulbadan laashe
Hai kitne dard ke manzar mere Hussain utho
Na poocho sham-e-ghareebaa’n ki bekasi ka samaa’n
Nabi ki Aal ke khaimo mein uth raha hai dhuwaa’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum aise haal mein jayen agar to jayen kahan
Hai ghash mein Abid-e-Muztar mere Hussain utho
Jalane aaye hain zalim qayam-e-Aale Nabi
Ghazab hai bistar-e-beemar mein bhi aag lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Faza mein goonj rahi hai sada-e-tishnalabi
Bapa hai qaimon mein mehshar mere Hussain utho
Hai beqarar bohot apki Sakina jaa’n
Fugha ye karti hai baba mere gaye hai kahaa’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Nahi hai taab tamacho ki aye phupi amma
Shakhi ne chheene hai gauhar mere Hussain utho
Ye kaisa haye bhara ghar ujad gaya bhaye
Sunaye kisko ye rudaad teri maajaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khadam khadam pa rulati rahegi tanhaye
Nahi hai koi bhi sar par mere Hussain utho
Sohail kehti thi rokar ye Zainab-e-Muztar
Watan ko jati hoon bhai mai dasht mein lut-kar
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda ko saumpa tumhe aye Nabi ke noore nazar
Hai daagh dil pa Bahattar mere Hussain utho
